text: [107] 17 aṭṭhahi bhikkhave ākārehi itthī purisaṃ bandhati . katamehi aṭṭhahi rūpena 5 bhikkhave itthī purisaṃ bandhati hasitena bhikkhave itthī purisaṃ bandhati bhaṇitena bhikkhave itthī purisaṃ bandhati gītena 6 bhikkhave itthī purisaṃ bandhati roṇṇena 7 bhikkhave itthī purisaṃ bandhati ākappena 8 bhikkhave itthī purisaṃ bandhati vanabhaṅgena 9 bhikkhave itthī purisaṃ bandhati phassena bhikkhave itthī purisaṃ bandhati . imehi kho bhikkhave #1 ma. - byathati patvā . 2 ma. uggavādiniṃ . 3 ma. chādeti . 4 ma. asandiddhañca #bhaṇati . 5 ma. ruṇṇena . 6 ma. ākappena . 7 ma. vanabhaṅgena . 8 ma. gandhena . #9 ma. rasena . aṭṭhahākārehi itthī purisaṃ bandhati tehi 1 bhikkhave sattā subandhāyeva 2 pāsena 3 bandhāti .
